topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: When I found out that my friend had been lying about their job, my first impulse was to feel disappointed. But as I processed what had happened, I realized how much more profound our friendship is than a single untruth. I decided to approach the situation with understanding. We all have moments when we’re not as honest as we could be, maybe out of fear or insecurity. I reached out to them, not to confront, but to offer a safe space to talk. It’s in moments like these that true friendships are tested and, with care, can become even stronger. I assured them that whatever the reason, I was here to listen, and we could navigate this together.
